space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 12
space.notes: The meta-planner test-bed's room (MPB; design_decisions.md, "The meta-planner test-bed (MPB)", MPB-2; analysis/kitting/mpb/README.md): the IRB's human side with a robot side added to the north. The human's side is env_layout_10's arrangement translated by (0, -200): kitting_table_0, shelf_1, shelf_2, coffee_machine_0 and corner_SE keep their relative places and their distances to the south and east walls, and 400 cm is added to the north for the robot's work; since the recognizer reads distances only, an IRB script run here has the IRB's trajectory, translated. Robot side: a north-east work area (kitting_table_1 with shelf_4, shelf_7, shelf_8, shelf_9); the crossing (shelf_5 and kitting_table_3 on the perpendicular bisector of the diagonal kitting_table_0 - shelf_1, crossing it at its midpoint (-210, 0)); the north-west pair for the occupied target (shelf_3 -> kitting_table_2, shelf_6 -> kitting_table_4, carries of equal length, the second walk 70 cm longer on the same bearing); two landmarks for the walker and the stand (door_N, spot_E). No door on the walls, no A/C switch, no obstacle. Authored for the physical facts MPB-2 needs, not for any expected number; the derivations: analysis/kitting/mpb/authoring.md.
